title: Day 1 — Creators
caption: The version of you that isn’t famous yet deserves a premiere. I put mine on the Dream Wall.
prompt: Vertical 9:16. Teen writes a dream in Notes; words become light, then a dream stage/viral moment; public Dream Wall; friends watch; warm dusk; no logos; end on glowing empty line.

title: Day 2 — Founders
caption: Your business exists. The world just can’t see it yet.
cta: Put the business on the wall
prompt: Hand writes “open a café”; ink becomes a glowing night storefront; then that scene appears on a plaza Dream Wall; cinematic, hopeful.

title: Day 3 — Romantics
caption: The dream you only admit at 1 a.m. still counts.
prompt: Night phone glow; vulnerable one-line dream; soft cinematic home/love/travel; dawn Dream Wall; intimate, never mocking.

title: Day 4 — Plaza FOMO
caption: Look up. Your dream could be next.
prompt: Time-lapse giant live Dream Wall filling; crowd grows; new dream blooms; cheer; night lights; event energy.

title: Day 5 — Late bloomers
caption: Starting later still deserves a spotlight.
cta: Give your second act a first audience
prompt: Adult writes a new-path dream; becomes classroom/studio/new city; dignified dawn light; wall of second-act dreams.

title: Day 6 — Artists
caption: Unreleased, but not unseen.
prompt: Sketchbook/lyrics lift into light → gallery/stage world → Dream Wall premiere; dramatic, beautiful.

title: Day 7 — Healing
caption: A quiet dream still belongs here. Anonymous is OK.
prompt: Soft handwriting about peace/health/home; calm morning visuals; anonymous glow on wall; no hustle energy.

title: Day 8 — Creators
caption: Don’t just caption your dream. Premiere it.
cta: Write the dream you’re scared to post
prompt: Thumb over Post → instead writes one dream → blooms as film on public wall → crowd looks up; Gen-Z, magnetic, not cringe.

title: Day 9 — Founders
caption: Public commitment > private overthinking.
prompt: Founder writes one sentence → first-customer/first-sale vision → wall premiere; urgent but warm.

title: Day 10 — Diaspora
caption: A dream that belongs to two homes.
cta: Write the dream for two places
prompt: Handwriting energy across cultures; light splits “home/here” then merges into one future; proud dusk wall.

title: Day 11 — Plaza FOMO
caption: 10 seconds. Whole plaza sees it.
prompt: Phone write → instant appear on massive screen → strangers react; fast joyful FOMO.

title: Day 12 — Parents
caption: Write one for them. Write one that’s yours.
cta: One for them. One for you.
prompt: Two lines bloom side by side on the wall — child’s future + parent’s quiet dream; golden, respectful.

title: Day 13 — Idealists
caption: Put the world you want where others can join it.
prompt: Collective dream (garden/city/community) blooms; others add related dreams; wall becomes a map of hope.

title: Day 14 — Creators UGC bait
caption: Reply with one dream. I’ll imagine the first ones on the wall.
cta: Comment your dream → then write it for real
prompt: Fast montage of 5 handwritten dreams becoming mini-films on a living wall; inviting, social, loopable.

title: Day 15 — Romantics
caption: Wanting a soft life isn’t small.
prompt: Cozy morning/home/freedom visualized from handwriting; public wall validates it; tender cinematic.

title: Day 16 — Founders
caption: Pitch decks can wait. Your dream shouldn’t.
cta: Put it on the wall today
prompt: Laptop closes; one line becomes a tiny brand world; plaza strangers watch it appear.

title: Day 17 — Artists
caption: Your gift needs a stage before the industry gives you one.
cta: Premiere the career you haven’t announced
prompt: Empty venue fills with light as an artist’s written dream plays on the Dream Wall.

title: Day 18 — Campus/Plaza
caption: Don’t just watch the wall. Join it.
prompt: Person at edge of crowd steps forward, writes, becomes the next film; invitation climax.

title: Day 19 — Late bloomers
caption: The dream you postponed is still yours.
prompt: Calendar pages fall; one honest sentence becomes a new life; soft close-ups.

title: Day 20 — Diaspora
caption: Let both worlds see what you’re becoming.
prompt: Journey light → arrival city → written dream → quiet crowd watches wall premiere.

title: Day 21 — Healing
caption: You don’t owe the hard part — only the hope.
prompt: Dark-to-dawn; one tender future scene; safe anonymous wall slot; soft breath-feel pacing.

title: Day 22 — Creators
caption: What if the internet saw your real dream first?
prompt: Bedroom → particles → dream life → that scene on giant shared wall; ends mid-wonder for loop.

title: Day 23 — Founders + social proof
caption: People are putting companies on the wall before logos exist.
prompt: Rapid sequence of storefront/app/studio dreams appearing on a busy Dream Wall; night energy.

title: Day 24 — Me-too romantics
caption: Someone else feels this too.
prompt: One love/home dream appears; another person writes a similar line; quiet recognition in the crowd.

title: Day 25 — Festival FOMO
caption: Tonight the wall is filling. Don’t leave yours unwritten.
prompt: Night plaza wall saturating with dreams; QR glow; countdown energy; last empty slot pulsing softly.

title: Day 26 — Parents
caption: Love built their world. Don’t erase yours.
prompt: Caregiving day dissolves into personal dream (studio/garden/degree); then public wall.

title: Day 27 — Idealists
caption: Hope is less lonely in public.
prompt: Night luminous wall of world-shaped dreams; soft cheer when a new one lands.

title: Day 28 — Artists
caption: Give your gift a public premiere.
prompt: Intimate making-of (hands, paint, voice) → explodes into public wall spectacle; hungry, beautiful.

title: Day 29 — All-audience trailer
caption: Write one dream. Watch it come alive for the world.
cta: Write my dream · Watch the wall
prompt: Master trailer: write → light → dream-film → crowd → empty glowing line waiting for next dream; warm, magnetic, viral.

title: Day 30 — Invitation close
caption: I wrote mine. The wall is waiting for yours.
prompt: POV walking to Dream Wall; blank luminous line; hand starts writing; cut to black with invite feeling; loop-friendly.
